contact._comment: Where 'Submit an idea and I'll build it' goes. If ideaFormEndpoint is left empty, the site opens the visitor's email client via a pre-filled mailto: link to ideaEmail — this works with zero setup on GitHub Pages. If you set up a form relay (e.g. https://formspree.io) and paste its endpoint below, the site will POST there instead and the visitor never leaves the page. See README.md > 'Wiring the idea form' for exact steps.

payments._comment: Used by the 'Sponsor this project' panel on every project card. No backend is involved — these are just the destinations the panel builds links/QR codes for.

theme._comment: Auto mode reads the visitor's IANA timezone (Intl API) and picks day/night by local clock hour, then a manual 3-way toggle (Auto / Light / Dark) in the top bar can override it. The override is remembered per-browser.
